text:
acme_ops: Heads-up: acme-corp reports sudden p99 jump (~1.2s) and a spike of 429s between 10:21-10:25 UTC. All on dedicated pool eu2-dedicated-04. No recent customer config change. They saw retries + billing alerts. Suspect noisy neighbor after autoscale policy tweak this morning.

acme_ops: key sample from their client logs: 
```
2026-03-16T10:22:14Z REQUEST id=XYZ123 status=200 latency_ms=48
2026-03-16T10:22:45Z REQUEST id=XYZ124 status=429 latency_ms=1204
2026-03-16T10:23:00Z REQUEST id=XYZ125 status=200 latency_ms=56
```

deploybot: autoscaler event: eu2-dedicated-04 scaled down  -> scaled up between 10:19-10:24, policy=v2-pack-fuse. Events: 10:19 scale down -1, 10:22 scale up +2 (trigger=cpu). Link: <https://internal.deploys/redwood/autoscale/3355556789> :information_source:

jordan_support: thanks. Can you attach the request ids and any tenant id? also dump of pool allocation at 10:20 would help. I've started a ticket for acme-corp (TKT-7891).

acme_ops: tenant: acme-tenant-17, request ids above are from their reproduction run. we'll upload full logs to the ticket. They ran steady qps=150 for 6m.

maya_sre: please grab MIG topology + nvidia-smi output from the host(s) allocated to acme at 10:20-10:25. Also need per-GPU metrics: sm_util, mem_bw, l3_util, and PCIe bandwidth. Commands: 
```
redwoodctl pool snapshot eu2-dedicated-04 --ts 2026-03-16T10:20:00Z > snapshot.json
ssh infra@node-eu2-213 "nvidia-smi topo -m; nvidia-smi dmon -s u -o TD"
```

kyle_infra: my hunch: fractional MIG packing caused transient hot-slice thrash when autoscaler added two new pods on the same physical host. Quick mitigations: migrate acme-tenant-17 off the hot slice -> move to isolation slice, set pool annotation pack_cushion:0.25, and bump min_replicas to 2 while we investigate. Also run a short stress test to reproduce: qps=200, duration=3m, random seed.

acme_ops: ran the stress test per kyle, reproduced 429s consistently when two co-tenants are warm on same host. We captured allocation snapshot: nodes: [node-eu2-213, node-eu2-217], MIG slices on node-eu2-213 showed concurrent SM saturation.

jordan_support: created an isolation request: infra-ticket IT-4523 to move acme-tenant-17 to eu2-isolated-09, scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-17 02:00UTC. Also noted potential billing adjustment for affected window.

maya_sre: follow-up for triage: please paste output of 
```
redwoodctl debug gpu-metrics --node node-eu2-213 --start 2026-03-16T10:18:00Z --end 2026-03-16T10:26:00Z
```
we're looking for SM bursts >90% and sustained L3 contention.

kyle_infra: also adding a temporary autoscaler safety: disable fractional packing for eu2-dedicated-04 for 1h, and revert if no regressions. I'll push a change: 
```
kubectl annotate pool/eu2-dedicated-04 infra.pack_cushion=0.25 infra.fractional_packing=false
```

acme_ops: confirmed: after moving off the hot slice in the repro run, p99 normalized to ~60ms and no 429s. They're happy with the temporary isolation.

jordan_support: action items: 1) infra to attach metric dumps and node logs to IT-4523 (kyle, maya) 2) support to confirm billing note and customer communication (jordan) 3) runbook update: add 'fractional packing quick rollback' (maya). I'll close the customer-facing loop once isolation completes. :white_check_mark:

maya_sre: noted, I'll add the runbook snippet and upload snapshots. Will follow up once we have full nvidia-smi + dmon trace.

kyle_infra: will execute the annotations and run a 15m monitor after the change. posting updates in the ticket.

acme_ops: thanks team. they want confirmation when autoscaler policy is reverted.

jordan_support: we'll confirm. tagging this thread in the ticket.

deploybot: note: change deployed to cluster eu2 at 2026-03-16T11:02:12Z (pack_cushion annotation applied).

maya_sre: preliminary conclusion: transient noisy-neighbor due to fractional MIG packing + autoscale churn. Root cause: co-located warm slices causing SM bursts and L3 thrash under specific load patterns. Recommend conservative fractional packing defaults for dedicated pools and a canary autoscale rollout.

jordan_support: summarizing for the customer: short-lived co-tenant contention after autoscaler added pods on same host -> we isolated tenant and applied temporary autoscaler constraints -> 429s resolved. Will follow up on permanent mitigation and billing.

acme_ops: closing loop with customer now. thanks all. :pray:
